title: langgenius/dify: a collaborative platform for agent and RAG workflows
friendlyTitle: Dify helps teams build and run AI agents and knowledge assistants
summary: Dify combines visual agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, model connections and deployment tools in one collaborative platform. It can run in the cloud, a private network or a self-hosted environment.
friendlySummary: Dify puts visual workflows, company-document search, AI models and deployment tools in one open-source platform.
whyItMatters: Teams can use Dify to move an internal assistant or RAG prototype toward deployment without assembling every orchestration component themselves. Review its licence, operational footprint and access controls for your intended scale.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to build an internal assistant or AI workflow more quickly. Check the licence, server cost and user permissions before rolling it out widely.
